title: cybianthus antillanus
intro: Cybianthus antillanus, commonly known as Island Cybianthus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. It is a shrub native to the Caribbean region, known for its medicinal properties and various uses. The health benefits of Cybianthus antillanus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-hypertensive properties.
